## What changed (required)

Describe the behavior or documentation changed and the affected callers.

## Why (required)

Describe the problem, the reason for this approach, and any meaningful trade-off.

## Evidence (required)

Give a reproducible command or scenario, its actual result, and relevant limitations. If a check did not run, say why. Link related issues here; use `Closes #123` for each issue this PR fully resolves.

## Testing (select what applies)

- [ ] Focused regression or acceptance check
- [ ] Full Go test suite
- [ ] Race tests
- [ ] CLI client acceptance
- [ ] Documentation or example scenario
- [ ] Other check (name the command and result above)
- [ ] A relevant check was not run (explain above)

## Author review (all required)

- [ ] I reviewed the final PR diff, including tests and documentation.
- [ ] I can explain what the PR does and which behavior changes.
- [ ] I can explain why this change is needed and why this approach fits.
- [ ] I checked the evidence that it works and accurately reported failures, skipped checks, and limitations.

Optional testing boxes describe what was actually exercised; do not check them to meet a quota. The four author-review attestations are required. This template does not perform automated review or approval.
